definitions.bt: BT(theta) in held situations (exact: held and in the family): max(p, 1 - p) < theta and no trace of sensor:g accepted or running -> trace_link sensor:g; such a trace pending -> monitor(300); otherwise p >= 0.5 -> the act-first playbook's choice, p < 0.5 -> replace_io_module source:g unless one is accepted, running or succeeded (then monitor(300)); outside held situations the act-first playbook (bt_<src>) or the GBM belief argmin (bt_<src>_gbm_fallback, same theta)
definitions.costly_gather_share: the same share among the decisions with both whose labelled gap (lowest observe J minus lowest non-observe J, scoring labels) is at least 10 cost points (costly_n)
definitions.gate: gated GBM: in held situations (exact: held and in the family, as in bt) gather (argmin of the GBM over observe candidates) if max(p, 1 - p) < theta, else the GBM argmin over non-observe candidates; elsewhere the GBM argmin; theta chosen on train with GBM predictions cross-fitted over the group_kfold split
definitions.gather_rate: share of the decisions with both observe and non-observe candidates in which the chosen candidate is an observe action
definitions.gbm: flat GBM (agents/flat_baseline.py) through train_direct.flat_predictions: fitted on train for each of the 8 grid points, the lowest val regret under its own training labels kept (as in the frozen evaluation); gbm_belief / gbm_hindsight: fitted on belief / hindsight labels
definitions.gbm_grid_points_below: number of the 8 GBM grid points (belief labels, fitted on all of train) whose val regret (belief/all) is below the rule's
definitions.held_detector: decision counts per split: family decisions, held situations, held in / outside the family, family decisions not held, decisions with several held groups, held decisions without a trace_link sensor:g or a monitor candidate, held family decisions without an exact posterior
definitions.held_situation: a sensor group g whose valid stale alerts cover >= max(2, 0.5 x its channels) distinct channels (agents/playbook.py group-wide staleness test); with several, the largest share
definitions.intervals: regret: point, 95% percentile cluster bootstrap over episodes (n_boot replicates, seed 0); minus_<ref>: method minus ref, paired cluster bootstrap on shared resamples, p_two_sided = 2 min(P(diff <= 0), P(diff >= 0)) over the replicates (0 means below 2 / n_boot)
definitions.margin: gather only if (lowest predicted J among observe candidates) - (lowest among the others) < -m, else the GBM argmin among the others; decisions without both families: plain argmin
definitions.margin_train: per fold split: 5-fold episode-grouped cross-fitted GBM (belief labels, the chosen belief grid point) on train; group_kfold = sklearn GroupKFold over candidate rows grouped by episode; seed<s> = the episodes in a random order of numpy seed s dealt round-robin to the folds; chosen_m = lowest regret (smallest m on ties); mean_curve = mean over the splits
definitions.margin_val: descriptive val values at VAL_MARGINS with the GBM fitted on all of train; minus_margin_0 = paired difference against m = 0
definitions.p_link_exact: P(link fault | E) from dec_posterior, the posterior of the episode's own cause (belief_sensitivity.family_cause gives the cause, also for pre-onset decisions); defined in the family only; privileged information (idealized observer)
definitions.p_link_lr: soft-label logistic regression (C=1, standardised features, each row as a link row with weight p and a module row with weight 1 - p) on posterior_features at g, fitted on the held train decisions with the exact posterior as target; train values cross-fitted over 5 episode-grouped folds (GroupKFold over the held decisions), val values from the fit on all of train
definitions.playbooks: the playbooks' recorded first actions (dec_baseline_act_first, dec_baseline_investigate_first)
definitions.posterior_lr_quality: on the held family decisions (train: cross-fitted values; val: the fit on all of train): mae_vs_exact = mean |p_lr - p_exact|; brier_vs_cause = mean (p - 1[link fault])^2 for p_lr, brier_exact_vs_cause the same for p_exact; map_agreement_with_exact = share in which p_lr and p_exact name the same likelier cause
definitions.regret: J of the chosen candidate minus the lowest J among the decision's candidates, under the scoring labels (belief: J_belief, the posterior mix over the link-vs-module pair; hindsight: J under the episode's true cause); mean over decisions
definitions.splits: train fits and selects everything (GBM cross-fitting, logistic posterior, theta, margin curves); val is scored once per rule; the test split is never read
definitions.theta_selection: theta in THETAS with the lowest mean train regret under belief labels (the smallest theta on ties); the lr posterior enters cross-fitted; gather_rate_held: share of the source's held decisions in which the rule chooses an observe candidate
definitions.train_references: train regret under belief labels of the playbooks' recorded choices and of the GBM argmin cross-fitted over the group_kfold split (the margin rule at m = 0 up to ties)
definitions.views: <scoring>/<subset>; all: every decision; family: the ambiguous decisions of the paper (dec_family: the episode's incident is a link fault on sensor:<g> or an I/O-module fault on <g>); backup_unavailable: scenarios without a backup channel (dec_backup_available false); family_backup_unavailable: both
